bulkStep1: Download the template and fill in student data (Username, First name, Last name, Gender are required). Use Invitation Type student or parent and Invitation Recipient Email to control where the Mailjet setup link is sent. Parent account columns apply only when Create Parent Account is yes.
bulkStep2: Upload your file (XLSX, XLS or CSV). A preview will show so you can fix any issues.
bulkStep3: Select the academic year and review the preview. Edit any cell if needed.
bulkStep4: Click Import to create students and send invitation emails. You will see a summary of successes and any row-level errors.

bulkFailedToParseFile: Could not read the file. Check the format (XLSX, XLS or CSV).
